findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: monitor_register_connector, monitor_register_template, pauhu_tm, source_search, code_read · Private data: pauhu_translate, monitor_register_connector, monitor_register_template, pauhu_tm, source_fetch_fragment, code_read, code_list, code_grep, code_diff · Public sink: monitor_register_template · Destructive: monitor_register_connector, monitor_delete_connector, monitor_delete_template, source_fetch_fragment, library_catalogue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: monitor_register_connector, monitor_register_template, pauhu_tm, source_search, code_read · Private data: pauhu_translate, monitor_register_connector, monitor_register_template, pauhu_tm, source_fetch_fragment, code_read, code_list, code_grep, code_diff · Public sink: monitor_register_template · Destructive: monitor_register_connector, monitor_delete_connector, monitor_delete_template, source_fetch_fragment, library_catalogue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
